summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of BuyReady MVP. Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass covering auth (demo/register/login/me), products (list/filter/search/sort/reviews-summary), BuyReady evaluate (fit+delivery+trust+value+why en/hi/te), better-choice, wishlist, cart, coupons, orders (create→advance through all 5 stages→monitor→feedback→return-options→return), notifications. Frontend: Playwright verified Demo Login → Home (banner, categories, 16 trending/recommended cards) → PDP (Priya's fit profile & Hyderabad address pre-selected, size L auto-recommended and highlighted) → Purpose sheet (Wedding + event date) → BuyReady Hero Card unlocked with 4 animated bars and 'Buy with Confidence • 87%' verdict → Why sheet (all 4 tabs fit/delivery/trust/value + voice langs en/hi/te) → Better Choice sheet (4 compare items with BuyReady Pick badge) → Add to Bag → /bag (item present, BUYREADY10 coupon applied with 10% off) → /checkout → confirm-order → /order-success → track-order → /track (timeline + live-map + ai-monitor) → simulated 4 progress advances to Delivered → fit-feedback-tight shows exchange suggestion → return-btn opens sheet with 4 alternatives → confirm return works. Wishlist and Profile tabs (orders/addresses/fit/settings + logout) and Notifications (13 real notifications) all functional.

issues: Event date uses native HTML <input type='date'> (browser default picker). Per design guideline this should ideally use a shadcn/ui Calendar/Popover component for consistent theming.

Several seeded products across categories (Kurtas, Sarees, etc.) reuse the same Unsplash image URLs, causing visible image duplication in the grids. Consider diversifying image_url in seed.py for demo polish.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace native date input in DecisionSteps purpose sheet with shadcn Calendar for consistency.
(Optional polish) Diversify product images in seed.py — several products share the same Unsplash URL causing repeated visuals in listings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 700 lines is close to the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, products, buyready, orders, cart) if adding more endpoints.

In /api/auth/register a duplicate email is caught by find_one lookup but there is also a MongoDB unique index on email created at startup — the pre-check is race-prone; consider catching DuplicateKeyError from insert_one as the authoritative check.
verify_pw does not handle bcrypt exceptions (e.g., malformed hash). Wrap in try/except to return generic 401 instead of 500 if a legacy/mangled hash is ever stored.

recommend_size uses BMI-derived index without bounds check when category!='Footwear' and product has <5 sizes — idx may exceed len(sizes)-1. Currently mitigated by out-of-stock fallback loop, but a min() guard would be cleaner.
predict_delivery treats pin[0]=='5' as 'same state' heuristic — works for Telangana/Karnataka only; documented as rule-based but consider a small pin-to-state map for hackathon polish.

advance_order allows any authenticated user to POST /orders/{oid}/advance for their own order — fine for demo, but there's no guard against calling it after delivered (returns delivered order silently). Consider explicit 400 to make the API contract clearer.

Frontend PDP evaluate() effect depends on [id, state] but omits `size` from deps despite reading it — eslint-disabled. Because size is only used for `!size` guard when auto-setting, it's fine, but the disable comment could hide future bugs.

CORS is set to allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — this combination is silently ignored by browsers per spec. If cookie/session auth is added later, replace '*' with explicit origins from env.
test_credentials: priya@buyready.in / Demo@123 (or POST /api/auth/demo). All 10 seeded users share password Demo@123. Coupons: BUYREADY10, MYNTRA20, FIRST50.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test suite uses the shared demo user Priya. Any orders created during tests are additive; register test creates TEST_-prefixed users which are left in DB (no unique-per-run cleanup required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 33 tests covering all major endpoints (7 test classes: TestAuth, TestProducts, TestBuyReady, TestShoppingBasics, TestOrdersFlow, TestNotifications). Runs in ~5s under pytest-xdist -n 2 (configured in /app/backend/pytest.ini — DO NOT modify addopts). BuyReady evaluate needs fit_profile_id + address_id + purpose to return unlocked=true; Priya has both seeded. Monitor delayed flag is deterministic per order id (~40%) — test only validates response structure. Frontend testids are comprehensive (data-testid on all buttons/inputs); use them not text selectors. Note: BottomSheet component renders body via AnimatePresence — always wait_for_timeout(400-600ms) after clicks that open sheets. BetterChoiceSheet needs ~2-3s wait after clicking better-choice-btn because it POSTs before rendering.
